abilities._comment: Was a plain STATIC, which nothing dispatches -- the ability never ran. WHILE_STATIC is re-evaluated on every attack-power recalculation. SOURCE_IS_ATTACK confines it to this card's own attack. The condition asked SELF_ATTACK_POWER_GTE 4 -- an absolute number. 'If this has {p} greater than its BASE' is a comparison against the card's own base power, which is ATTACK_POWER_GT_BASE.
